title: Uncles Marcus and Louis, father Lorenzo Sr., and brother as reed players
summary: Tio describes his guitarist aunts, his uncles Marcus and Louis (the latter a bassoon player) and his father Lorenzo Sr., with his brother following the father on all reed instruments.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And my grandfather's sister was a guitarist. And they moved here after my grandfather died. My grandmother moved here, which I had an uncle, Marcus Teo. He was an also crying at us.
Never knew of him at all.
Well I knew. And he was the oldest of the family. And I came, I had an aunt after him. She was also a guitarist. But they never was made famous, in better words. After they left Mexico, excuse me.
Did you hear anything, I was going to ask you to interrupt, anything you know about the family in Mexico, where they studied music or which city they came from?
You never heard them say whether they came from Mexico City or down that far or where it was?

Tampico, Mexico. I know where they came from. Tampico, Mexico. Tampico. Tampico and somewhere around in Veracruz. You were in two places. But for, when you're a youngster, you don't remember these things. Yes, that's right. Well, they came here. They had my uncle Marcus. He was a crying at us. Well, and my uncle Louis, he was also a crying at us. He was a bastoon and an old boy at playoff. Now, he was older than your father, was he? He was older than my father. But Marcus was the oldest of all of them.
Do you know when, do you have the dates when they died and were born by any chance? Or do you, could you guess about when it was?
I wouldn't be able to give you that right off the reel.

And because I was pretty young and I don't remember these things, but I probably might be able to get it for you. When you were born and all that kind of stuff. Then I had my father. He was also a kind of saxophone, a bastoon player.
Lorenzo Senior. That's my father. Well, he was, then my brother followed in his footsteps. That came, he played all the reed instruments.
